notes.title: New patch delivered!
notes.content:
Greetings fellow Postmen!

We have launched a patch to improve Paperman: Adventure Delivered. We hope you will have a more smooth experience with these improvements and fixes implemented.

Go on now then, take care of that greedy dragon!

Patch notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed multiple animations
[*] Fixed a number of audio glitches
[*] Fixed multiple collectibles
[*] Fixed "Healthy Work Environment" trophy
[*] Fixed the screen showing a colourful explosion when pressing alt-tab at the wrong time
[*] Fixed multiple wind tunnels
[*] Fire tunnels are dangerous again
[*] Fixed item throwing directions by characters
[*] Fixed Paperman's rotation bug, when using lock-on during boss fights
[*] Fixed camera in the second fight against the big dragon not following the player, when the first player is not Paperman
[*] Fixed meteor attack in the second fight against the greedy dragon colliding with the ceiling
[*] Improved Tutorials
[*] Improved consistency with picking up packages
[*] Improved enemy pathfinding
[*] Improved many cameras
[*] Improved stick-sensitivity
[*] Other players can now skip the intro video at the beginning of the worlds too
[*] Removed a little rock in world 2 which caused damage to the player
[*] Removed NPC with an invisibility cloak (or potion)
[*] Rebalanced some of the puzzles
[*] Added some button call outs
[*] Additional fixes
[/list]

notes.title: 3D co-op platformer Paperman: Adventure Delivered is available now on Steam!
notes.content:
Greetings Postmen!

The game has been delivered simultaneously in all major territories on Steam! You'll finally be able to discover the different worlds, puzzles and characters! ːsteamhappyː

If you're not so familiar with Paperman: Adventure Delivered yet, don't worry! We've made a quick [i]All You Need To Know[/i] guide and a Launch trailer just for you! 
[list]
[*] Inspired by the classic 3D platform, collectathon games.   
[*] Up to 4 players local co-op in split-screen!
[*] Play with 4 charming characters, each with their own skillset: 
[list]
[*] [b]Paperman [/b]the mail carrier has the ability to throw envelopes and teleport short distances.
[*] [b]Express[/b], our runner envelope is the quickest of all four and moves at lightning speed.
[*] [b]Carl[/b], the strongest box of the bunch has a lot of strength and has no problem moving heavier objects.
[*] [b]Scrolly[/b], shaped like a traditional scroll, reaches different heights by gliding with this feather into cyclones or even creating small gusts of wind of his own.
[/list][*] Swap characters at a moment’s notice at the mailbox. 
[*] Fly, jump, run, teleport and push your way through the colorful worlds. 
[*] Explore 3 open worlds with ancient temples, scorching hot deserts and mountain peaks.
[*] Activate hidden platforms, turn on wind tubes and solve challenging puzzles.
[*] Find hundreds of collectible items and collect all golden letters. 
[/list]

[previewyoutube=VFwKsm0LWCA;full][/previewyoutube]

We wish you the best of luck in your journey to retrieve all the mail and defeat de greedy dragon!!

notes.title: Paperman: New Demo Delivered ✉️
notes.content:
[h3]It's time to retrieve the lost mail and get it delivered! 📫[/h3]

Jump right into the very first [b]thirty minutes[/b] of the [b]first world[/b], where you will meet your team on [b]Manyfaced Island[/b].🏝️ Get familiar with each of the four mail carriers and swap characters to put their special abilities into practice. Solve puzzles, overcome obstacles and find the missing letters along your journey!  

We hope you'll enjoy the first experience of the game, feel free to share any feedback about Paperman: Adventure Delivered, if you have any questions, please let us know!


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1887310/Paperman_Adventure_Delivered/

notes.title: Announcement with new trailer | Paperman: Adventure Delivered
notes.content:
We are happy to announce Paperman: Adventure Delivered with new [b]keyart[/b] and a [b]trailer[/b] for our a new 3D Platform adventure!

In the 3D Platform game Paperman Adventure Delivered, you’ll explore colorful worlds trying to find back the lost mail and defeat the greedy dragon. Play as each of the four unique mail carriers and swap characters to unlock their unique abilities. 

[b]MEET YOUR TEAM HERE:[/b]
[previewyoutube=gsPlaGAIglo;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]MAIN FEATURES[/b]
•	Inspired by the classic 3D platform, collectathon games.   
•	Up to 4 players local co-op in split-screen.
•	Activate hidden platforms, turn on wind tubes and solve challenging puzzles.
•	Find hundreds of collectible items and find all golden letters. 
•	Play with 4 playable charming characters, each with their own skillset: 
[list]
[*] Paperman the mail carrier has the ability to throw envelopes and teleport short distances.
[*] Express, our runner envelope is the quickest of all four and moves at lightning speed.
[*] Carl, the strongest box of the bunch has a lot of strength and has no problem moving heavier objects.
[*] Scrolly, shaped like a traditional scroll, reaches different heights by gliding with this feather into cyclones or even creating small gusts of wind.
[/list]
Paperman: Adventure Delivered is planned for release on [b]September 2023[/b] both digitally (on PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Nintendo Switch, Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S and PC – Steam and Windows) and physically (on PlayStation 5 and Nintendo Switch).
